Identity fields unchanged; titles stand.

glyph_rationales.0: the first station of the record's own movement path: ground before any move.

glyph_rationales.2: the second station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.3: the third station of the record's own movement path.

glyph_rationales.8: the eighth station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.the seat: the seat — the occupied place itself: an agent's standing is a seat in a real tree, not an abstraction.
glyph_rationales.the lane: the lane — the bounded track a lane works inside; the claim drawn around the work.
glyph_rationales.the claim: the claim — one attribution in the register: who is here, on what, since when.
glyph_rationales.the co-worker: the co-worker — the second agent beside the first on the same seat; presence shared.
glyph_rationales.the place: the place — the checkout as a held place — four walls of working tree.
glyph_rationales.the join: the join — the act of attaching to a standing lane; arrival into a situated existence.
glyph_rationales.the ground held: the ground held — the machine and its trees; the material ground a workcell exists on.
glyph_rationales.5→0: the path's own completion sign: the last move returns into the first.
glyph_rationales.→: the move itself: one term passing into the next, continuity drawn as an arrow of motion.
glyph_rationales.∴: therefore: the record's claim standing after its own reasons.
glyph_rationales.×: the crossing: one encounter meeting another without either dissolving.
glyph_rationales.Ω: the closing term: the path arrived at its end, which is its ground.
